light_setup: 420 nm LED array wrapped around coil

streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic dictates single stream. Flow rate derived from calculation Step 9 (Q_total = 0.500 mL/min) to achieve target productivity.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all components can be mixed prior to irradiation. Single stream feed implies pre-mixing or inline mixing of substrate/catalyst solutions if fed separately, but here defined as single stream A.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and photocatalyst in acetonitrile to 0.1 M.
Ensure solution is exposed to air or sparged with air to saturate with O2 (oxidant).
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine to sulfoxide using air as oxidant. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1) and photon-limited. Flow design prioritizes short residence time (0.3 min) and high surface-to-volume ratio (1.0 mm ID) for efficient light penetration and O2 transfer. No BPR needed as T=21C is well below MeCN bp. FEP tubing used for 420 nm transparency.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 estimated tau = 0.3 min. Batch time was 5 min. Flow advantage (IF=15x) suggests significant reduction. 0.3 min is the calculated target for 99% conversion.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Liquid-only basis as O2 is dissolved in the liquid phase from air saturation, not fed as a separate gas stream in this specific stream logic.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (21 C). No thermal acceleration needed.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. T=21C is far below MeCN bp (82C).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP selected for transparency to 420 nm light (Photocatalysis rule).
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.1 M from Batch Protocol and Chemistry Plan.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated from V = Q * t = 0.5 mL/min * 0.3 min = 0.15 mL. Closest standard inventory coil volume.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Calculation Step 3. Balances light penetration (smaller is better) and pressure drop.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min from Calculation Step 9 to match productivity targets.
